newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Orient interim net down 58.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Asia Orient interim net down 58.5 pct.

text.p: Company name Asia Orient Holdings Ltd

NOTE - Asia Orient Holdings Ltd was incorporated in Bermuda on June 28, 1996. Pursuant to a scheme of arrangement under section 166 of the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance, which became effective on September 17, 1996, Asia Orient Co Ltd (AOCL) became a wholly owned subsidiary of the company. The shareholders and warrant holders of AOCL received shares in and warrants of the company on a one-for-one basis, in consideration for the cancellation of their shares in and warrants of AOCL.
The business and underlying assets of the company and its subsidiaries have remained unchanged after the implementation of the scheme.
